setup.command: mise install go@1.26.5 && ln -sf "$HOME/.local/share/mise/installs/go/1.26.5/bin/go" /usr/local/bin/go && ln -sf "$HOME/.local/share/mise/installs/go/1.26.5/bin/gofmt" /usr/local/bin/gofmt && (command -v git-lfs >/dev/null 2>&1 || (apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq git-lfs))
